use default
use System

use COMMAND = (word: string, minimum: int)

let table =
    "add 1  alter 3  backup 2  bottom 1  Cappend 2  change 1  Schange  "
    "Cinsert 2  Clast 3  compress 4 copy 2 count 3 Coverlay 3 cursor 3  "
    "delete 3 Cdelete 2  down 1  duplicate 3 xEdit 1 expand 3 extract 3  "
    "find 1 Nfind 2 Nfindup 6 NfUP 3 Cfind 2 findUP 3 fUP 2 forward 2  "
    "get  help 1 hexType 4  input 1 powerInput 3  join 1 split 2 spltJOIN "
    "load locate 1 Clocate 2 lowerCase 3 upperCase 3 Lprefix 2  macro  "
    "merge 2 modify 3 move 2 msg  next 1 overlay 1 parse preserve 4 "
    "purge 3 "
    "put putD query 1 quit  read recover 3 refresh renum 3 repeat 3 "
    "replace 1 Creplace 2 reset 3 restore 4 rgtLEFT right 2 left 2  save  "
    "set  shift 2  si  sort  sos  stack 3 status 4 top  transfer 3  "
    "type 1  "
    "up 1"

let commands = LIST[COMMAND]()

for token in table.split([' '], StringSplitOptions.REMOVE_EMPTY_ENTRIES) do
    let minimum mut = 0

    if int.try_parse(token, minimum ref) then
        let last = commands.count - 1

        commands[last] = (word = commands[last].word, minimum = minimum)
    else
        commands.add((word = token, minimum = token.length))
    fi
od

matches(command: COMMAND, word: string) -> bool =>
    word.length >= command.minimum /\
    word.length <= command.word.length /\
    string.compare(
        command.word.substring(0, word.length),
        word,
        StringComparison.ORDINAL_IGNORE_CASE
    ) == 0

expand(word: string) -> string =>
    commands
    |> filter(command => matches(command, word))
    |> map(command => command.word.to_upper())
    |> first() ?? "*error*"

let input =
    "riG   rePEAT copies  put mo   rest    types   fup.    6       "
    "poweRin"

write_line(
    input.split([' '], StringSplitOptions.REMOVE_EMPTY_ENTRIES)
    |> map(expand)
    |> join(" ")
)
